2. 因為前代理 ``worker-X`` 的認證已被撤銷且與票據相關的某些信息 ``[m2, m3]`` 都來自它，但因為沒有一相應的檔案來確認，向工作者發起 ``reassign_lookup`` 請求。

```json
{"tool": "lookup_record", "args": {"customer_id": "C-1132"}}
```

Result: {"customer_id": "C-1132", "name": "Adatum Ltd", "seat_count": "not stored in CRM (see contract system)", "refund_eligible": true, "eligible_amount": 120, "status": "open"}
